utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hana, I’m still waiting on confirmation for the tool person and the drop-off spot, so I’d rather we call Saturday morning tentative until the organizers firm it up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That makes sense, Pia — I’ll mark Saturday morning as tentative and hold off announcing until the tool person and drop-off spot are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thank you, Hana — if anyone asks, please just say we’re verifying logistics and I’ll share the confirmed drop-off details once the organizers answer.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I’m bringing drills, clamps, the spare workbench, and a bunch of hand tools for Saturday’s repair drive—anything you think we’ll be short on?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. If you’ve got spare extension cords, power strips, and a few labeled bins for parts, those are what we’ll probably miss.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good call, Leo—I’ve got a couple extension cords, power strips, and some labeled bins, so I’ll add those to the pile for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Vik, I’m trying to get the repair drive details straight before I pass word around—have you heard the confirmed time, drop-off spot, or whether they still need tools and handy volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve only got confirmed that it’s today this afternoon and they need useful repair supplies—tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks; Cleo’s keeping the official list, so I’d check with her for the exact drop-off spot and volunteer needs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik—that’s enough for me to say it’s this afternoon and supplies are welcome, but I’ll check with Cleo before I name the drop-off spot or call for volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Uli, I’m keeping the repair drive supply list, but I’m still confirming the biggest needs—so far I’ve got tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks noted. Do you know of anything pledged or any gaps I should verify?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t heard any firm pledges yet, Cleo—just that Sam’s tracking repairs and tools quietly. I can let you know if anything specific comes my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli—that helps. I’ll hold off marking anything as pledged and just note that Sam may have the quiet repair/tool picture until we can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, I’m trying to pull the repair drive threads together—right now we’re keeping it focused on small appliances, torn clothing, and basic bike tune-ups. Do you know if Sam’s tool crew or Marco’s cyclists are already looped in?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m slammed and only caught bits, but I did ask Sam what he needs from me—haven’t heard enough to say his tool crew is confirmed, and I don’t know about Marco’s cyclists yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo—that helps. I’ll mark Sam’s crew and Marco’s cyclists as not confirmed yet, and I’ll check in with them directly so you’re not carrying it while you’re slammed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rey, I’m still working off second-hand updates, but I’ve heard tools, spare parts, and handy volunteers are the main needs so far. Do you know who’s coordinating the signups?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t confirmed the signup coordinator yet, Nell. I’d rather ask Rosa or Oren directly before pointing folks anywhere, but I can help sort parts or coffee once the time is set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds sensible, Rey—if you check with Rosa or Oren, I’ll hold off on naming a coordinator and just tell folks you may be able to help with parts or coffee once the timing’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, I’m helping coordinate the repair drive this Saturday morning and keeping track of tables and supplies—are you able to lend a hand or bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Sam, I can lend a hand Saturday morning, and I’ll bring screwdrivers, pliers, a wrench set, and an extension cord. I’d like to check Mina’s sign-up list first so we set the tables by repair type and don’t double up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds perfect, Eli—thanks for bringing those tools. Let’s check Mina’s list first, then we’ll sort the tables by repair type and make sure nothing gets duplicated.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Faye, I’m just catching up as usual—sounds like the drive is mostly small appliances, torn clothing, bike tune-ups, and maybe screen door patches. Do you know what help or supplies you still need?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — I’m still waiting on the organizers to confirm the date, busiest slots, and what’s already covered, so I don’t want to guess yet. Once I have the verified repair list and supply needs, I’ll loop you in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Faye—thanks for keeping it careful. I’ll hold off on asking folks for supplies until you’ve got the verified list, then I can help fill gaps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal, I’ve started spreading the word and I’m asking everyone to jot down their block plus any tools or broken items they’re bringing so your station map stays accurate.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Quinn—please have them send me those notes by block as they come in, and flag anything bulky so I can leave enough space on the map.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Opal—I’ll have folks send their notes by block as they come in, and I’ll make sure anything bulky gets flagged for extra space.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, I’m still piecing together today’s repair drive details while I’m out—Quinn’s helping with outreach, and I think Eli wants verified info, but do you know who has the current repair list?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ira, I might be a step behind, but I don’t think I’ve got the current repair list—maybe check with Leo or Pia before Eli sends anything wider.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Noah—that helps. I’ll check with Leo or Pia next before telling Eli anything firm.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina, I’m helping coordinate the repair drive details—are you looking to help with outreach, station setup, or a volunteer time slot?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mara, I need the current repair list and sign-up sheet first—who has them, and which stations are still uncovered?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I don’t have the current repair list or sign-up sheet yet, Mina—I’ll check with Quinn and Opal since they’re handling logistics. From what I know, Opal’s station layout and volunteer matching should tell us which stations are still uncovered.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oren, before I pass anything along, can you confirm the repair drive date and what repairs or supplies are actually needed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Kira, I can confirm we’re collecting tools this afternoon—I'm bringing spare screwdrivers and a socket set—but I’d better not swear to the repair drive date. Last I heard they wanted small appliance and bike fixes, plus parts-sorting and coffee help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Oren—that helps on tools and needs, but I’ll wait to share the date until Faye or the organizers confirm it. Can you point me to whoever’s handling the official details?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Rosa, I’m still holding off on telling folks until we’ve got the repair drive time, drop-off spot, and tool person confirmed—have you heard any of those for sure?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—time and place are set now: Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the porch. I’m still confirming the tool person, so hold off on that part until I give you the final name.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa—that helps a lot; I’ll only pass along Sunday at the community center for now and keep quiet about tools until you confirm the name.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you have the latest sign-up sheet and repair list, or am I still chasing those from Vik and Ira?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Mina, I may have the older sign-up notes, but I’d still check with Vik and Ira for the latest repair list before we announce anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Send me the older notes now, Oren, and I’ll mark them as unconfirmed while I chase Vik and Ira for the current list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Gus, before we tell folks anything, can you confirm exactly where you’d drop off the drills, clamps, and workbench, and what time window works for you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia—I can drop the drills, clamps, and workbench at the community room side door between 9 and 10 Saturday morning, unless you’d rather have them somewhere else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus—that helps a lot. I’ll check that the community room side door is definitely okay with Leo before we share it widely.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Ira, I’m keeping the repair drive supply list, but I’m still confirming what’s most needed before I mark anything down. Have you heard of any pledged supplies or gaps I should verify with Mara or the block chat?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Cleo—so far I’ve heard folks should bring tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks, and Quinn is helping with outreach. I haven’t heard firm pledges yet, so I’d verify gaps with Mara or the block chat before marking anything down.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira—that matches what I’ve heard, so I’ll keep those as likely needs but not firm pledges yet. I’ll check with Mara or the block chat before I mark any gaps down.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m helping keep the repair drive focused for now: small appliances and basic bike tune-ups, with drop-off by Friday evening and no bulky items yet.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules—that helps a lot; I’ll pass along small appliances and basic bike tune-ups only, drop-off by Friday evening, and no bulky items for now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Mara—if anyone from your circle has tools or bike stands to lend, send them my way and I’ll match them up with the right lane.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Noah, I’m helping coordinate the repair drive this Saturday morning—could you lend a hand with setup or bring any small repair tools if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Absolutely, Sam—I can help with setup Saturday morning, and I’ll try to bring screwdrivers, pliers, a wrench set, and an extension cord if I don’t misplace the note again.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Noah—that would be a huge help. I’ll count you in for setup Saturday morning, and those tools sound perfect if you can bring them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, I’m just catching up, but it sounds like Jules is grouping things around small appliances, clothing repairs, and bike tune-ups—do you know what help or supplies are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—I've got those three stations penciled in, but I still need exact table spots, extension cords for small appliances, sewing kits and extra needles, and a bike stand or two; can you tell me where Dane's crew can cover?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can cover rounding up extension cords and one bike stand, and I’ll ask my folks about spare sewing needles too. I’m late to the details, but I can check back tonight with what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Rey, I heard you might be able to help with sorting or coffee—can you confirm which one you’re comfortable taking on before I add your name to the list?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, Hana—put me down for sorting parts. I can help with coffee too if you’re short, but sorting is the one I’m most comfortable committing to.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I’ll mark you as confirmed for parts sorting, and keep coffee as a backup only if we’re short.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, Faye — I can cover the 3 to 5 after-school drop-off window, just send me the confirmed date and any details I should tell families.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — that helps a lot. I’m still waiting on Mara to confirm the date and busiest slots, and I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll hold off telling folks anything specific until you hear from Mara, but plan on me for that 3 to 5 window.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Quinn — please send me the confirmed date and accepted repairs from the actual notice before I pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Kira — I’ll check the actual notice first and send you only the confirmed date and accepted repairs before you share anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — once you’ve checked the notice, send me a photo or exact wording too so I can verify it before sharing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Uli, I’m still gathering second-hand updates on the repair drive—so far I’ve heard tools, spare parts, and handy volunteers are needed, but do you know who’s actually coordinating it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think Quinn’s been getting the word out, and Sam’s keeping track of repairs and tools. Leo might be the one sorting the volunteer side, but I’d check quietly with one of them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Uli—that helps a lot. I’ll check quietly with Quinn or Sam before passing anything along, and maybe ask Leo about volunteers once I know that’s right.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo — the repair drive is today, and Cleo’s keeping the list. Bring useful supplies if you can: tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I’ll bring tools, tape, spare cords, and a snack box, and I’ll send folks to Cleo for the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, thanks Leo — I’ll keep telling folks you’re bringing those, and I’ll point anyone with list questions to Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, I’m joining a bit late, but so far I’ve heard the drive is centered on small appliances, loose bike brakes, torn clothing, and screen door patches—are you looking to help with any of those?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane—that matches what I’ve been trying to confirm. I’m keeping the supply list, so I’ll mark likely needs for appliance tools, bike brake bits, sewing kits, and screen patch materials until Mara or the block chat verifies them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That sounds smart, Cleo—maybe mark them as tentative for now, and I’ll check back once I hear who’s holding the confirmed signup list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Uli—I’m mapping the repair stations for the drive, so tell me where you’ll be stationed and what tools or supplies should be nearby.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not fixed to a station yet, Opal—probably just helping where it’s quiet for a little while. If you can, put me near small lamp or chair repairs, with basic hand tools nearby.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Uli—I’ll mark you as a floater near the small lamp and chair repair area, with basic hand tools close by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, please check with that Birch Street person today and find out if volunteers are the real gap, and whether they know the time or drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can do that today, Mina—I’ll ask the Birch Street person specifically about volunteers, timing, and the drop-off spot, then pass along only what they confirm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please get it back to me by this evening so I can stop guessing and tell Tess something solid.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Current plan is Saturday morning collection, and I’ll have the parts list set by noon. Come early if you can, and I’ll point you to a specific task.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, Leo—Saturday morning collection, parts list by noon, and I’ll come early so you can assign me where I’m actually useful. Also, is the drop-off spot confirmed yet before I tell folks?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not confirmed yet—I’m checking with Pia and Opal on the exact spot. Tell folks Saturday morning for now, and I’ll send the drop-off point once it’s locked.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Tess, I’m still out running errands, but latest I’ve got is Cleo has the supply list and Quinn’s handling outreach—tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks are helpful for this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh perfect, thanks Ira—I’ll pass along that Cleo has the supply list and Quinn’s on outreach, and I’ll tell folks tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks are useful this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess—that’s exactly what I’ve got so far. I’ll keep checking on who has the actual repair signup list while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus, I’m pretty swamped but trying to pitch in on the repair drive—do you know who’s coordinating volunteers or what help they still need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, Noah’s been organizing the repair drive, so I’d check with him on volunteer gaps. I’m already bringing drills, clamps, the spare workbench, and some hand tools, so extra hands for setup and sorting might be welcome.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus—that’s helpful. I’ll check with Noah and see if he needs me on setup or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still fuzzy on the actual meeting time, Rey, so I don’t want to invent it—but Vik confirmed we’re collecting tools this afternoon. And sorting parts or keeping coffee going would be exactly the kind of help they need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren—that helps. I’ll plan to help with tools and sorting this afternoon, and I’ll wait on a confirmed meeting time before telling anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s perfect, Rey—thank you. I’ll check back with Vik for the confirmed meeting time before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Faye, I haven’t heard back yet from the organizers, but I remember you’re hoping for mid-morning or early afternoon around school times—I’ll check in again and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara, I really appreciate you checking again—once you hear back, I can firm up whether I can cover mid-morning or early afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Faye—I’ll nudge Quinn and Opal today and ask specifically about mid-morning or early afternoon needs, then I’ll circle back as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, I’m still waiting on the organizers to confirm the tool person and the exact drop-off spot, so I’d hold off on announcing details beyond Saturday morning for now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — small update, it’s actually been moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll hold off on the tool person and drop-off specifics until the organizers confirm.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thank you, Rosa — I’ll treat Sunday at the community center as the current plan, but I still won’t circulate tool or drop-off details until we get the organizers’ confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, I’m trying to line up the repair drive lanes—could your tool crew take the small appliance fixes while I check with Priya on sewing and Marco on bike tune-ups?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that works—my tool crew can handle the small appliance lane Saturday morning, and I’ll make sure our table and supplies are clearly marked.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Sam—I’ll note your crew for small appliances Saturday morning and sync with Priya and Marco so the lanes stay clear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, first I’d like us to check Mina’s sign-up sheet and sort it by repair type, then we can see which fixes and volunteers are still missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds sensible, Eli, but can you confirm Mina’s sheet is the latest version before we sort it and start telling people what’s missing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I’ll confirm with Mina that it’s the latest sheet before we sort anything or tell folks where the gaps are.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Hana, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive so nobody misses it—would you like the details, or know anyone with tools or something that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please send me the confirmed details first—what repair categories are covered, when and where it’s happening, and who’s already committed to each lane?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Hana—I’m still gathering the confirmed lanes and commitments, so I’ll send you the solid details as soon as Opal’s map is finalized.
